outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original fantasy battle sprite animation sheet. Bow continuous with one string physically attached ends; keep trunk/root anatomy crown branches and shoulder tendrils consistent. No new characters, extra bows, separate trees, scenery, ground shadows, effects, text or gore. Detailed original painted strategy art matching reference. Real bending/joint poses not translated copies. Whole crown/bow/root base uncropped.

sources.prompt:
Edit the supplied ORIGINAL game-unit sprite sheet, preserving the SAME 4-column by 4-row arrangement, same 1536x1024 canvas, camera, cell scale, character identity and original painted style. This is an original living-tree archer called Graft Matriarch, not any existing franchise character. It has exactly TWO functional pale birch arms, two decorative looped shoulder branches (not extra arms), a tall branch crown, green moss torso, amber resin nodes, one red-bound curved branch bow and an articulated ROOT SKIRT, never human legs. Face the combat opponent toward screen RIGHT.

Change ONLY these six cells, indexed row-column starting at 1:
R2C2 melee windup: put the seed arrow away. Both hands grip the solid wooden bow stave across the torso, pulled BACK toward the body ready for a short physical two-handed shove. No string drawn, no arrow, no shooting pose.
R2C3 melee contact: same bow and same two grips as R2C2, both arms extended toward screen RIGHT, shoving the rigid wooden bow stave into an adjacent enemy. This is a physical close-range bow-stave shove, not shooting. Root skirt braces naturally. No enemy or VFX.
R4C1 dying buckle: keep the original silhouette and equipment placement; amber eyes and all resin nodes darken to dull opaque brown amber, no light emission.
R4C2 side collapse: same original silhouette; eyes inactive and amber resin dull dark brown.
R4C3 prone dead and R4C4 settled corpse: retain full connected trunk, crown, shoulder loops, roots and original bow lying beside the hands. Make eyes closed/dark and ALL resin nodes opaque dark brown, no orange glow, no alive-looking bright lamps, no new leaves or objects.

Preserve all OTHER TEN cells as closely as possible. Keep every crown tip, bow tip and root inside its own cell, clean separation and no text. Output a transparent-background raster PNG with genuine alpha, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Make empty bow-string triangles, shoulder loops and gaps between arms transparent too. Preserve pale birch bark and gold bowstrings; never erase them as background. No shadow or floor, no colored matte, no labels, no motion lines. Deliver the complete updated sheet.
sources.review: Unselected whole-sheet action/death attempt: melee still retains seed arrow and ranged-like gesture; retained as precursor only.
